activity.overview: Listen to a story about bundling straws. Find the tens and ones.
activity.passage: Sam has a big pile of straws. Counting them one by one takes a long time! So Sam puts 10 straws together with a rubber band. That is one bundle of ten. Sam makes 2 bundles. There are 5 straws left over. Sam has 2 tens and 5 ones. That is 25 straws.

questions.prompt: How many straws are in one bundle?
How many bundles of ten did Sam make?
How many straws were left over?
How many straws does Sam have in all?
Why is it faster to count by tens? Tell a partner.

activity.subject: mathematics
activity.title: Sam's Straws
